_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate (score ±2 in 3% of 12h windows) plus canceling divergences make HOLD the skilled default inside 39-46 until volume expands.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on phase Anxiety and non-directional stance; Narrative simply lower conviction and headline-silent
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound, phase score holds 39-46, no volume expansion next sessions
next_move.invalidated_if: Vol-expansion range break: fear_greed into mid-20s on breakdown, or squeeze lifting 30d momentum and sentiment out of chop
